notes: The supplied text is Ventura College's Course Identification Numbering System (C-ID) page, not the California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) page; it prints no requirements, totals, outcomes or careers for the Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement.
Many closed-list courses appear in the C-ID designation table, but that table only maps local courses to C-ID numbers and does not state award requirements, so no blocks were recorded.
The navigation lists a 'California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC)' page under Transfer Information; a reviewer should fetch that page to record this certificate's requirements.
